user_problem: A proposed message sequence needs logical progression based on supplied audience states and permitted transitions.
unique_output: A sequence map showing entry condition, message purpose, prerequisite knowledge, transition rule, and stop condition.
required_input: Approved messages, audience states, transition rules, timing constraints, exclusions, and terminal conditions.
critical_rule: Do not predict engagement or send anything; missing transition evidence must remain a design gap.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is marketing-campaign-brief; this models logic within a supplied sequence rather than defining an entire campaign.
acceptance_scenario: Input states New→Informed after reading overview, Informed→Ready after viewing demo, stop after opt-out; messages are overview and demo invitation. Output orders them, cites transitions, and includes immediate opt-out termination.
